business_boundary: Buyer-side acquisition decision support; no autonomous approval authority.

modules.business_purpose: Define transaction perimeter, process stage, counterparties, timing, scope and mandate constraints before analysis.
modules.decision_relevance: Prevents strategic conclusions from using the wrong deal perimeter or decision date.
required_research_questions: What exactly is being acquired and at what process stage?
Which perimeter, timing and mandate constraints govern the decision?
required_claims: Transaction perimeter and process context are explicitly defined.
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least one replayable mandate or transaction record supports each material context claim.
counterevidence_requirements: Record conflicting perimeter, timing or transaction-form information.
assumption_requirements: Label any inferred perimeter or timing as an assumption.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose unresolved scope, timing or consideration-form questions.

modules.business_purpose: Diagnose the buyer capability, growth, portfolio or defensive need independent of the target.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests whether the buyer has a real need rather than a target-led narrative.
required_research_questions: What buyer-side strategic need exists without reference to this target?
How material and time-sensitive is the need?
required_claims: A specific buyer strategic need exists and is material.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Primary buyer records support need, materiality and urgency.
counterevidence_requirements: Test whether internal build, partnership or status quo addresses the need.
assumption_requirements: Separate management aspiration from evidenced need.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose missing buyer capability or portfolio baseline.

modules.business_purpose: Explain why acquisition is an appropriate response to the buyer need and why now.
modules.decision_relevance: Distinguishes acquisition rationale from the existence of a buyer need.
required_research_questions: Why acquire rather than build, partner or defer?
Why is transaction timing strategically justified?
required_claims: Acquisition is a defensible response to the buyer strategic need.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Evidence supports acquisition logic and alternative rejection.
counterevidence_requirements: Present credible build, partner and do-nothing alternatives.
assumption_requirements: Label untested speed-to-market or scarcity assumptions.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose alternatives not costed or tested.

modules.business_purpose: Assess the target as an acquisition candidate on scarcity, access, quality and relative attractiveness.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests why this target deserves attention before asserting strategic fit.
required_research_questions: Why is this target attractive relative to credible alternatives?
Which attributes are scarce, durable or replicable?
required_claims: The target is attractive on defined buyer-side criteria.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Material attractiveness attributes have replayable evidence and comparators.
counterevidence_requirements: Record substitute targets, replication paths and quality concerns.

modules.business_purpose: Verify target capabilities and underlying business quality, including customers, economics, scalability and durability.
modules.decision_relevance: Prevents capability labels from substituting for business-quality analysis.
required_research_questions: Which target capabilities are proven and transferable?
What is the quality and durability of the target business?
required_claims: Business quality is sufficient for acquisition consideration.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Capability and business-quality claims use independent replayable records.
counterevidence_requirements: Record churn, concentration, technical debt and capability-transfer constraints.
assumption_requirements: Label unverified transferability, retention and scalability assumptions.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose unavailable customer, product or quality data.

modules.business_purpose: Assess industry structure, growth, rivalry, substitutes, entry barriers and target competitive position.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests whether target quality persists in its competitive environment.
required_research_questions: How attractive and structurally durable is the industry?
What is the target competitive position and threat set?
required_claims: The industry and competitive position support the strategic thesis.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Market and positioning claims state date, scope and source.
counterevidence_requirements: Test substitutes, price pressure, disruption and adverse market scenarios.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose missing market shares or competitive response data.

modules.business_purpose: Synthesize buyer need, rationale, target attributes and competitive context into a fit thesis without claiming value creation.
modules.decision_relevance: Determines whether the strategic thesis merits progression to economics.
required_research_questions: How exactly do target capabilities meet buyer needs?
What dependencies could break strategic fit?
required_claims: A traceable buyer-target strategic fit exists.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Every fit link traces to buyer-need and target-capability evidence.
counterevidence_requirements: Record capability overlap, incompatibility and missing fit links.
assumption_requirements: Do not treat strategic fit as proven synergy or value creation.

modules.owning_block: Block B: Value Creation and Pricing
modules.business_purpose: Establish normalized historical and forecast standalone revenue, EBITDA, cash flow, working capital and debt economics.
modules.decision_relevance: Provides the baseline before synergies, financing and purchase price effects.
required_research_questions: What are normalized standalone earnings and cash flows?
Which forecast drivers and quality-of-earnings adjustments are supportable?
required_claims: Standalone financial performance and forecast are decision-usable with explicit adjustments.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Historical, normalized and forecast figures retain source and adjustment lineage.
counterevidence_requirements: Record adverse trends, normalization reversals and cash conversion issues.
assumption_requirements: Forecast drivers must be explicit and supported or conditional.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose unavailable financial, cohort or working-capital data.

modules.owning_block: Block B: Value Creation and Pricing
modules.business_purpose: Define revenue, cost, capex and working-capital synergy mechanisms, timing, ownership, probability, dis-synergies and implementation costs.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests whether strategic fit converts into measurable value creation.
required_research_questions: What operational mechanism creates each synergy?
What timing, probability, cost, dis-synergy and owner apply?
required_claims: Value creation is mechanism-based, probability-adjusted and net of implementation costs and dis-synergies.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Each material synergy has a baseline, driver, timing, probability, owner and evidence.
counterevidence_requirements: Record dis-synergies, customer losses, execution constraints and overlap limits.
assumption_requirements: Unsupported synergy assumptions cannot be presented as fact.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose unvalidated synergy mechanisms or timing.

modules.owning_block: Block B: Value Creation and Pricing
modules.business_purpose: Triangulate valuation and enforce maximum purchase price, premium, value-sharing and walk-away discipline.
modules.decision_relevance: Prevents strategic attraction from overriding buyer value capture.
required_research_questions: What valuation range is supported by standalone and synergy economics?
What price boundary preserves buyer value and defines walk-away?
required_claims: Offer price is within an evidenced purchase-price boundary.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Inputs and methods are sourced, sensitivity-tested and independently replayed.
counterevidence_requirements: Show downside valuation, overpayment risk and seller value capture.
assumption_requirements: Valuation assumptions require support and sensitivity ranges.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose missing price, net debt or share-count inputs.

modules.owning_block: Block B: Value Creation and Pricing
modules.business_purpose: Assess consideration form, funding sources, leverage, liquidity, dilution, covenant, tax and structural consequences.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests whether the buyer can fund and structure the transaction within constraints.
required_research_questions: How will consideration and financing be structured?
What are pro forma leverage, liquidity, dilution and covenant impacts?
required_claims: Deal structure and financing remain within buyer constraints.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Funding inputs and structural terms are traceable and replayable.
counterevidence_requirements: Record covenant, liquidity, refinancing, dilution and tax risks.
assumption_requirements: Financing availability and terms must be explicit assumptions until committed.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose uncommitted financing or unresolved legal/tax structure.

modules.owning_block: Block B: Value Creation and Pricing
modules.business_purpose: Evaluate ROIC, IRR, payback and scenario returns against buyer thresholds.
modules.decision_relevance: Converts price, synergies and financing into buyer return discipline.
required_research_questions: Do base and downside returns exceed mandate thresholds?
Which assumptions and sensitivities drive return outcomes?
required_claims: Returns meet explicit buyer hurdles under defined scenarios.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Every return input is traced and every formula independently replayed.
counterevidence_requirements: Show downside, delayed synergy and financing stress scenarios.
assumption_requirements: Return claims distinguish fact, forecast and assumption.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose missing cash flows or return thresholds.

modules.owning_block: Block C: Risk, Diligence and Decision
modules.business_purpose: Track diligence workstreams, findings, red flags, unresolved questions, conditions and owners.
modules.decision_relevance: Ensures decision claims remain within completed diligence boundaries.
required_research_questions: What has each diligence workstream established?
Which findings, red flags and unknowns remain decision-material?
required_claims: Diligence coverage and limitations are explicit.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Every material finding links to a workstream record and owner.
counterevidence_requirements: Record adverse findings and management rebuttals separately.
assumption_requirements: No absent diligence result may be invented.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Uncompleted workstreams and unanswered requests remain visible.

modules.owning_block: Block C: Risk, Diligence and Decision
modules.business_purpose: Assess merger control, foreign investment, sector, data, licensing and transaction approval risks.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests legal feasibility, timing, remedies and closing risk.
required_research_questions: Which regulatory approvals and theories of harm apply?
What timing, remedy, prohibition and closing conditions are plausible?
required_claims: Regulatory path, uncertainty and required counsel review are explicit.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Jurisdictional and substantive claims use current authoritative sources.
counterevidence_requirements: Record adverse precedents, overlaps, political and remedy risks.
assumption_requirements: Legal conclusions remain conditional pending qualified counsel.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose unresolved filing, jurisdiction and remedy questions.

modules.owning_block: Block C: Risk, Diligence and Decision
modules.business_purpose: Assess operating-model, technology, people, culture, customer and execution integration risks.
modules.decision_relevance: Tests whether capability transfer and synergy delivery are operationally credible.
required_research_questions: What must be integrated, preserved or ring-fenced?
Which dependencies threaten capability, customer, talent or synergy retention?
required_claims: Integration risks, owners, mitigations and value-at-risk are explicit.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Material integration risks trace to affected value drivers.
counterevidence_requirements: Record cultural conflict, talent flight, customer attrition and systems complexity.
assumption_requirements: Retention and integration timing assumptions remain visible.
explicit_unknown_requirements: Disclose untested operating-model or systems dependencies.

modules.owning_block: Block C: Risk, Diligence and Decision
modules.business_purpose: Synthesize adverse scenarios, value-at-risk, covenant/liquidity stress and walk-away triggers.
modules.decision_relevance: Makes loss cases and resilience explicit before recommendation.
required_research_questions: Which adverse scenarios most threaten thesis and returns?
What are the quantified impacts, mitigations and walk-away triggers?
required_claims: Material downside scenarios and walk-away triggers are decision-usable.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Downside drivers link to evidence and replayable calculations where quantifiable.
counterevidence_requirements: Do not offset downside with unverified upside.
assumption_requirements: Scenario severity and probability assumptions are explicit.

modules.owning_block: Block C: Risk, Diligence and Decision
modules.business_purpose: Produce a machine-readable Go / No-Go, conditional, renegotiate, pause or human-review decision state within authority boundaries.
modules.decision_relevance: Synthesizes business gates without replacing human approval.
required_research_questions: Which decision state is supported by all gate evidence?
What conditions, unresolved gaps and walk-away triggers remain?
required_claims: Decision state follows gate outcomes and preserves conditions, uncertainty and human review.
minimum_evidence_requirements: Recommendation statements trace to criteria, evidence, calculations and gate history.
counterevidence_requirements: Adverse evidence and failed criteria remain visible in the decision state.
assumption_requirements: No decision threshold or approval may be invented.
explicit_unknown_requirements: All unresolved material unknowns and owners are listed.
